name: EIB
recent: Ecoscience International Berhad 在 2026 年 11 月 20 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的业绩，录得 470 万令吉归属于股东的亏损。此前，公司董事在 2026 年 10 月至 11 月期间有股份交易活动，公司近期没有发布重大合约或企业活动公告。
notable: 公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，录得 470 万令吉归属于股东的亏损。
执行董事兼董事经理 Wong Choi Ong 在闭市期外增持 160,000 股普通股。
risks: 最新季度录得亏损，且净亏损率较上一季度扩大。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，公司营收为 2,937 万令吉，环比下降 8.6%，同比下降 15.0%；净亏损为 1,106 万令吉，净亏损率为 37.7%，而上一季度净亏损率为 10.7%。

recent_en: Ecoscience International Berhad announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 20 November 2026, recording a loss attributable to shareholders of RM4.7 million. Earlier, there were director share dealings in October and November 2026, including a disposal by Operational and Technical Director Tia Tuan Sim during the closed period. The company has not announced any major contracts or corporate activities recently.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, recording a loss attributable to shareholders of RM4.7 million.
Operational and Technical Director Tia Tuan Sim disposed of 254,000 ordinary shares during the closed period.
Executive Director and Managing Director Wong Choi Ong acquired 160,000 ordinary shares outside the closed period.
risks_en: The Operational and Technical Director disposed of shares during the closed period.
The latest quarter recorded a loss, with the net loss margin widening compared to the previous quarter.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM29.37 million, down 8.6% QoQ and 15.0% YoY; net loss was RM11.06 million with a net loss margin of 37.7%, compared to a net loss margin of 10.7% in the previous quarter.
